answer_1.quote: Neural text generation models have ubiquitous applications in natural language processing, including machine translation, summarizations, dialogue systems, etc.

answer_2.quote: We use both BLEU and BLEURT, an advanced model-based metric, as the automatic metrics for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We also perform human evaluations on Yelp data to further test the transfer quality. ... The three annotators are asked to evaluate which sentence is preferred as the transferred sentence of the original sentence, in terms of content preservation and sentiment transfer.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate which sentence is preferred based on content preservation and sentiment transfer.
